svg.text: A city stacked down the face of a colossal sea wall: the station on the crest, three streets of tiers, the docks on the quay at its foot, the sea and the Lily beyond.

g.text: station on the wall top, +60 m
the port: hotel, bank, chapel, saloons

svg.text: Vertical: four tiers and 60 m of drop. Lifts, stairs and coal
chutes join them; fights come from above and below, and a fall
is a shortcut. Cliffs west, flats east, where the wall ends.
Arrive at the crest station, on the wall top
Win the marker: the Gilded Parlor, tier one
Down the lifts to the launch quay
Board up the anchor chain to the bow
a bounty fought on the cage
THE GILDED LILY · THE DECKS WE PLAY
true scale: 180 m long, 24 m across · bow to the right · the launch drops you under the bow; climb the anchor chain to the foredeck
UPPER DECKS · promenade, lifeboats, funnels, bridge
